fields.description: Download and compress a remote file and store it in a cab file on local machine.
fields.name: Suspicious Diantz Download and Compress Into a CAB File
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "diantz.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " \\\\" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".cab"))
